mechanisms.behavior: The target-down NO contact is in series with the NC back contact. A back hit breaks and restores switch 17 while the drop is down; both fresh native runs pulse reset output 1 on restoration. The raised target then clears switch 17. The table's TRUE/FALSE pulse and forced raise are a workaround.
mechanisms.label: Single drop and back target

mechanisms.behavior: Five captive balls accompany two free balls: one behind the left bank operates 28, one behind the single drop operates the back contact of 17, and a shared center ball transmits momentum to two inside balls at 33/34. Completing outside targets 29–32 enables letter awards on inside hits; simultaneous inside hits award two letters and a flash. Travel and animation timing remain table tuning.

Embryon's solenoid sheet marks the PB4/CONT.2 load N/U. All four raw runs show a shared 17-20 boot pulse, each rising/falling callback set within 1 ms before scenario switch actions. Pinned by35.c:357-359 complements PIA1:B's high nibble (data ^= 0xf0) and maps the whole bank via (data & 0xf0)<<12; exact timestamps and source hash are in the compact solenoid seed. The no-load drawing plus explained public bank behavior supports unused 17. The precise firmware instruction and why the ROM initializes the bank are untraced; transitions do not establish physical fitment.
